mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has recovered from -54.9% to -36.6% over three weeks, signaling normalization of essential shopping patterns. This stabilization at a higher level indicates consumer confidence and reduced fear, which will sustain elevated RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as consumers resume discretionary shopping alongside essential trips.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 18.3 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -80% or declines more than 5 percentage points from the current -82.7% baseline.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility has recovered from -84.1% to -70.6% over three weeks, indicating public confidence in mass transit safety and resumption of commute patterns. When TRANSIT rises above -70%, consumers regain access to retail districts, directly enabling higher RETAIL_REC footfall in the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT exceeds -70% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 13.5 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility falls below -75% in any of the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the baseline mean of -86.7%.

This behavioral shift will translate to higher retail-and-recreation mobility as consumers gain confidence to visit enclosed retail spaces, producing elevated RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -50% for one week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved 36.6 percentage points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS mobility falls below -60% in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC remains below -85% for three consecutive weeks.

fact:TRANSIT improved 13.5 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT declines more than 10 percentage points in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed -75% by week t+2w.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stabilized at +28.0% in t-0w after +27.9% in t-1w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above +35% or falls below +20%, indicating renewed panic or further lockdown; RETAIL_REC remains below -85%.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-May in Tokyo marks the transition into warmer weather and the approach of summer holiday season. Historical seasonal patterns combined with observed recovery trends across all mobility categories suggest natural seasonal uplift in retail-and-recreation activity. RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks due to seasonal demand independent of restriction changes.
evidence_refs: fact:Decision point is 2020-05-15, mid-spring transitioning to summer in Tokyo
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean of the last 28 days (-86.7%), or shows no seasonal uplift pattern by week t+4w.

When WORKPLACES exceeds -65%, TRANSIT exceeds -70%, and RESIDENTIAL stabilizes below +30%, authorities have likely implemented phased reopening policies. Under this regime, RETAIL_REC will rise as retail establishments receive permission to operate at higher capacity.

failure_condition: Any of the three proxies moves outside its trigger range for two consecutive weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines below -85% in the next four weeks.
